VIPCOO VS9 – Dual Motor Off-Road Electric Scooter
The VIPCOO VS9 is a high-performance dual motor electric scooter engineered for riders who demand power, range, and all-terrain capability. With a combined 3600W output (2 × 1800W), a 60V 26Ah lithium battery, and a top speed of 40 mph, the VS9 is one of the most capable off-road electric scooters available in the UK.
Power & Range

Dual 1800W Hub Motors – 3600W combined peak power for rapid acceleration and confident hill climbing
60V 26Ah Battery – Extended range per charge with dual charging ports for faster top-up
3 Speed Modes – Ride at your pace; unlock up to 40 mph in performance mode

Off-Road Performance

11" Pneumatic Off-Road Tyres – Superior grip and shock absorption on gravel, mud, and uneven terrain
Front & Rear Hydraulic Spring Suspension – Absorbs bumps for a smooth, controlled ride on any surface
High-Carbon Steel Frame – One-piece construction built to handle demanding off-road conditions

Safety & Braking

Triple Braking System – Dual hydraulic disc brakes combined with electronic braking for maximum stopping power
IPX4 Water Resistance – Ride confidently in light rain and wet conditions
Full Lighting Suite – Dual-lens LED headlights, turn signals, brake light, stem ambient light & reflectors

Smart Features & Convenience

LED Dashboard Display – Real-time speed, battery level, mileage, and gear mode at a glance
Quick-Fold Mechanism – Double safety lock for secure, compact storage and transport
Dual Charging Ports – Reduce downtime with simultaneous charging capability

Who Is the VIPCOO VS9 For?
The VS9 is the ideal choice for commuters who want off-road versatility, adventure riders exploring trails and mixed terrain, and anyone seeking a powerful electric scooter for adults that doesn't compromise on safety or build quality. Whether you're navigating city streets or tackling countryside paths, the VS9 delivers a confident, exhilarating ride.

All VIPCOO scooters are quality-checked before dispatch.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the top speed of the VIPCOO VS9?
The VS9 has three speed modes. In its highest (unlocked) performance mode, it reaches up to 40 mph. For everyday commuting, lower modes provide a safer, more controlled ride.
How far can the VS9 travel on a single charge?
Range depends on rider weight, terrain, and speed mode. The 60V 26Ah battery is designed for extended rides — typical range is approximately 40–60 miles under mixed riding conditions.
Is the VIPCOO VS9 suitable for off-road use?
Yes. The VS9 is purpose-built for off-road riding with 11" pneumatic tyres, front and rear hydraulic spring suspension, and a reinforced high-carbon steel frame. It handles gravel, mud, grass, and uneven terrain with ease.
Does the VS9 fold for storage and transport?
Yes. The VS9 features a quick-fold mechanism with a double safety lock, making it easy to store at home, in a car boot.
Is the VS9 waterproof?
The VS9 carries an IPX4 water-resistance rating, meaning it can handle light rain and splashes. It is not designed for submersion or riding through deep puddles.
What braking system does the VS9 use?
The VS9 uses a triple braking system consisting of dual hydraulic disc brakes (front and rear) plus an electronic brake, providing reliable, responsive stopping power in all conditions.
How long does it take to charge the VS9?
With dual charging ports, you can charge both ports simultaneously to significantly reduce charge time. Exact charge time varies by charger output — please refer to the included charger specifications.
All scooters are quality-checked before dispatch to ensure they arrive in perfect condition.
